description: Customer & SLA rules used to score and prioritize incoming network incidents based on affected customer tier, contractual SLA, and business impact.

rules.name: Platinum Tier Critical Escalation
rules.description: Any incident affecting a Platinum-tier customer's core service is auto-escalated regardless of raw severity score

onMatch.reason: Platinum customer impacted at {affectedLayer} layer — auto-escalated to P1

rules.name: Customer Tier Base Weight
rules.description: Assigns a base priority weight according to customer tier

rules.name: Affected Customer Count Multiplier
rules.description: Incidents impacting a large number of customers receive a scaling multiplier

onNoMatch.reason: Affected customer count below mass-outage threshold

rules.name: Contractual SLA Breach Risk
rules.description: Flags incidents at risk of breaching the customer's contracted SLA response window

onMatch.reason: Incident at 80% of SLA response window ({minutesSinceIncidentOpened} min elapsed) — imminent breach risk

rules.name: Business-Critical Service Type
rules.description: Boosts priority for services tied to business-critical customer operations (e.g. enterprise leased lines, hospital connectivity)

onMatch.reason: Service flagged as business-critical for this customer

rules.name: Repeat Incident Penalty
rules.description: Increases priority for customers with repeated unresolved incidents within a rolling window, to prevent chronic issues being deprioritized

onMatch.reason: Customer has {incidentCountLast30Days} incidents in the last 30 days — chronic issue flag

rules.name: Maintenance Window Suppression
rules.description: Suppresses or downgrades incident priority if it falls within a pre-approved planned maintenance window

onMatch.reason: Incident occurred during approved maintenance window — suppressed for non-Platinum customer

rules.name: Regulatory / Emergency Service Line
rules.description: Hard override for incidents affecting emergency services or regulatory-mandated lines (e.g. E911, public safety)

onMatch.reason: Emergency/regulatory service line affected — mandatory SEV1 override, bypasses all other scoring

slaMatrix.description: Default response/resolution targets by customer tier and derived severity, used when a rule does not explicitly override slaResponseMinutes/slaResolutionMinutes

conflictResolution.description: Rules evaluated in ascending 'priority' order. An ESCALATE outcome with an explicit priorityScore short-circuits and overrides the accumulated additive score. A SUPPRESS outcome zeroes out further additive scoring unless a subsequent ESCALATE rule (e.g. emergency line) overrides it. Priority 0 rules (regulatory/emergency) always evaluate first and can bypass all other logic.

explainabilityTemplate.rulesEvaluated: list of all rule IDs checked
explainabilityTemplate.rulesMatched: list of rule IDs whose conditions were satisfied
explainabilityTemplate.rulesRejected: list of rule IDs whose conditions failed
explainabilityTemplate.humanReadableExplanation: concatenation of each matched rule's 'reason' field with substituted field values
